title: The Eye of Sauron Saw Everything...But Subsequent Legal Challenges
subtitle: After any major corporate downfall, the discovery process can be brutal
text:
This humor newsletter is absolutely going to be dumb. It’s for my own amusement. It’s a “repository of legal documents” unearthed in the discovery process of a series of lawsuits filed in the aftermath of the action at the end of the Lord of the Rings.

Without further ado…

Subject: Urgent Compliance Issue: Mordor's One-Ring Search Failures

To: All Senior Management and Compliance Officers CC: Legal Department, Audit Committee, Board of Directors Date: April 13, The Third Age

Dear Colleagues,

I am writing to bring to your attention an urgent compliance issue that has arisen concerning our organization's handling of the One Ring search failures. We have received reports from multiple sources suggesting potential non-compliance with our internal policies, regulatory requirements, and ethical standards. Immediate action is required to rectify this situation and maintain the integrity of our operations.

Summary of the Issue:

During the course of the search for the One Ring, several serious lapses have been identified:

• Inadequate risk assessments and contingency planning in the event of search failure.

• Insufficient oversight and monitoring of field agents and their activities.

• Failure to report search progress and setbacks to the relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.

• Inadequate communication and collaboration between various departments involved in the search.

Potential Consequences:

These lapses in compliance could lead to severe consequences, including but not limited to the following:

• Loss of credibility and reputation with our stakeholders.

• Legal and financial penalties arising from non-compliance with regulations.

• Strained relationships with key partners and suppliers.

• Long-term damage to our competitive advantage in the industry.

Immediate Actions Required:

To address this urgent compliance issue, the following actions must be taken immediately:

• Initiate an internal investigation to determine the extent of the non-compliance and identify all parties responsible.

Can we confirm if any action was taken on this item? —STW 10/22 The Third Age 09:34

• Engage external auditors and legal counsel to assist with the investigation and ensure objectivity.

• Halt any ongoing activities related to the One Ring search until proper compliance measures are in place.

This is going to be problematic at trial —GWT 10/20 The Third Age 21:09

• Implement additional controls and safeguards to prevent future non-compliance incidents.

Next Steps:

We are scheduling an emergency meeting with all Senior Management and Compliance Officers on [Date and Time1] to discuss the situation and formulate a comprehensive action plan. In the meantime, we request that you review all relevant documentation, policies, and procedures related to the One Ring search.

We take this matter very seriously and are committed to resolving it swiftly and effectively. Your full cooperation and support are essential to achieving a successful outcome.

Thank you for your attention to this critical issue.

Sincerely,

Origar, Chief Risk Orc,

Mordor Inc.

1Risk management internal audit: are you kidding me? Origar neglected to date and time THIS document? —Compliance Reviewer #794639 10/28 The Third Age 11:93 GWT

Reply from senior audit officer: it appears so. Please keep editorial comments off of official documents as per policy. This is all discoverable. —Sr. Compliance Auditor #08837 10/29 The Third Age 17:35 STW
